runs.brief: audience: residents watching a river; use cases: check level, get alert; tone: delegated -> utilitarian
notes: First Hallmark run in this project — no rotation constraint to satisfy.
No root tokens.css: this project's tokens are HSL triplets in src/styles/globals.css bridged via tailwind.config.ts. A root file would be dead code Vite never loads.
Skipped Cobalt's signature code-card (no code to show) and its light/dark band rhythm (the app already has user-chosen light/dark/high-contrast modes).
Introduced the font stack — nothing in the project declared a font before this run.
Added --rule token in all three colour modes for hairline structure.
